status: exploratory (validation only; test results were already consulted earlier in the project)
init: init_weights(seed) (= first 3 layers of Exp. 3's initial weights)
shuffle: torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed) (verified identical to the official global randperm after set_seed)
balancing: undersample(X_train, y_train, seed), ratio 1:1, 295 fraud + 295 legit = 590 per seed (verified)
encoder: AngleEncoder(4, seed) fitted on the 1:1 set
noise_model: noisy_qnode: NATIVE_GATES decomposition, DepolarizingChannel(p) after every gate on every wire, default.mixed
threshold: max F1 on validation scores at the same p

official_configuration_confirmed.split: 60/20/20 stratified, seed 42; train 170,883 (295 fraud), val 56,962 (99), test 56,962 (98)
official_configuration_confirmed.undersampling: all training frauds + as many legit drawn without replacement, rng = default_rng(seed), then permuted
official_configuration_confirmed.feature_map: ZZ: H + RZ(2 x_i) per qubit; per pair i<j: CNOT, RZ(2(pi-x_i)(pi-x_j)), CNOT; FEATURE_MAP_REPS = 2
official_configuration_confirmed.ansatz: EfficientSU2-style: RY+RZ per qubit, linear CNOT ladder, x ANSATZ_REPS + final rotation layer; params = (ANSATZ_REPS+1)*4*2; ANSATZ_REPS = 3 (32 params)
official_configuration_confirmed.training: Adam, lr 0.05, batch 32, BCELoss, 30 epochs, best validation AUPRC epoch
official_configuration_confirmed.noise: depolarizing p = 0.001, 0.01, 0.05 after every native gate on every qubit, default.mixed
official_configuration_confirmed.metrics: AUPRC (primary, p = 0.01 and 0.05), AUROC, Spearman rho, precision, recall, F1, MCC; threshold max F1 on validation at the same p; mean +- std over >= 5 seeds
official_configuration_confirmed.cost: training = epochs * 590 * (1 + 2P); validation = epochs * n_val; 1024 shots per execution

differences_vs_official: dedicated shuffle generator (same permutations as official)
